title: RailOS Canonical Sensor Event
description: Canonical sensor event schema for the RailOS Pilot System (Design §4.3, Req 1 C2-C8)

eventId.description: UUID v4 unique identifier for the event

sourceId.description: Edge node or source system identifier

sensorType.description: Type of sensor producing this event

assetId.description: Track segment or rolling stock asset identifier

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the sensor reading

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number per sourceId

quality_flags.description: Data quality metadata attached to every canonical event

interpolated.description: True if any values in the payload were linearly interpolated

interpolation_pct.description: Percentage of payload values that were interpolated (0-100)

clock_reliable.description: False when source clock drift exceeds 100ms threshold

drift_ms.description: Measured clock drift in milliseconds relative to PTP grandmaster

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the canonical schema (currently 1.0.0)
